summary: The adversarial gate fails. The existing header reader accepts corrupted magic bytes. Filesystem failures print stack traces. The original suite passes.
blocking_findings: ADV-1 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: tests/sound-set.test.ts:299,306 decodes magic bytes with toString('ascii'), which clears each high bit. The reader accepts 0xcf instead of ASCII O and 0xf6 instead of ASCII v. Rationale: AC3 steps 1 and 5 require exact ASCII bytes. The two high-bit corruption tests at tests/sound-set.adversarial.test.ts:269-274 fail because the existing reader throws no error. Route to Green: compare the byte sequences without lossy decoding. Preserve these failing regressions.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-2 [Nit] adversarial-testing: scripts/sound-set.mjs:71 lets rmSync exceptions escape. A directory at alpha.ogg prints 24 stderr lines. A 300-character name prints 17 stderr lines. Rationale: D5 requires one controlled failure line, but defines no exact text for these filesystem failures. This confirms review-b F3 and extends its input class. Tests at tests/sound-set.adversarial.test.ts:201-227 fail on the line count. Route to Green: contain these exceptions and preserve directory contents.

All unicode, whitespace, traversal, non-string-design, validation-order, extra-key, and argv-boundary cases pass.
